newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Material Handling sees gains from regions.
newsitem.headline: Material Handling sees gains from regions.

text.p: Material Handling Engineering Ltd (MHE) said on Thursday it expects its regionalisation efforts to cushion the slowdown in the electronic sector.
Chairman Peter Boo Song Heng said in the company's annual report the company was seeking to establish a marketing base in Indonesia and China in 1997.
The company is involved in the design, fabrication and installation of conveyor-based integrated automation systems,
Boo said a memorandum of understanding for a trading and investment joint-venture in Burma, in which it would own a 70 percent stake, had been signed to tap further opportunities.
He said it had completed a Singapore $2 million colour television assembly line for a manufacturer in India this year.
In Malaysia, the company would focus on the automobile and related industries, and had completed an assembly line for the national motorcycle project.
Boo said labour shortages in Singapore and Malaysia would contribute to a sustained demand for automated assembly systems and robotic systems.
He said he expected the core business of material handling to continue to form a major portion of the group's turnover.
For the year ended June 1996, the group's turnover was Singapore $23.9 million.
